sources.finding: The official yearbook shows robotics, DIY machines and kinetic/large-scale exhibits.
The official circular-economy overview emphasizes reuse, regeneration, materials management and hands-on workshops.
The official 2025 program includes crafted robot fighters, robot-car programming, teardown and soldering workshops.
sources.interpretation: Playful homemade robots; Small robots. Big ideas.

sources.finding: The official 2025 call presents AI and More Things as the theme, connecting technology, creators and tangible innovation.
sources.interpretation: Circuit-board artwork; From bits to things / Make it real.

note: Creative interpretations of regional programming. Date-free concept series; no claim of an official commissioned campaign.
